meta.title: Reschedule an upcoming event: move the start 2 hours later

plan.title: Reschedule Upcoming RFQ by Two Hours

steps.note: Open the prepared upcoming RFQ directly on its project summary page.
Move the event start two hours after its current start and verify the save, preserved round length, and shifted end time.
Confirm the event remains upcoming after rescheduling, because Reschedule Event is still offered.
